test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 4 minutes while another pipe can empty the tank in 8 minutes. If both pipes are opened simultaneously when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-quarter of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Filling time = 4 minutes

Emptying time = 8 minutes

Required work = 1/4 of tank

**Formula Used:**

Work = Rate × Time

Net work = Filling − Emptying

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 4 and 8 = 8

⇒ Total work = 8 units

⇒ Filling rate = 8 ÷ 4 = 2 units/min

⇒ Emptying rate = 8 ÷ 8 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Net rate = 2 − 1 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Required work = (1 ÷ 4) × 8 = 2 units

⇒ Time = 2 ÷ 1 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**
